notes.title: Patch 5
notes.content:
[b]Here are the patch notes (1.10.28):[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed various issues in combat causing "ghost" hits and animation errors
[*]Fixed issue with "MEGA" boost button not disappearing after the "normal" boost timed out
[*]Updated several of the newer knockout sounds that wasn't centered
[*]Knocking out an opponent now regains stamina
[*]Reduced "Repair service 3" cost from 180k to 150k
[*]Reduced "Expand gym 3" cost from 500k to 300k
[*]Fixed text alignment and correct hover cost for manager talent "Well Connected"
[*]Boxer passive "Ravager" no longer activates when opponent successfully blocks the incoming hit
[*]Swarmer passive "Windwalker" no longer activates when opponent successfully blocks the incoming hit
[*]Brawler passive "Entertainer" no longer activates when opponent successfully blocks the incoming hit
[*]Major improvements to scouting sponsorship deals for all competitions ([i]The scout can now negotiate with a current sponsor to renew and extend duration for current deal and increase payment per day. This system now works together with the reputation and VIP invitations score to give bonuses for keeping the same sponsor a longer period of time and inviting this sponsor to fight events[/i])
[*]Increased chance for scout to improve current sponsorship deal and extend duration
[*]Increased chance for scout to find sponsorship deal that atleast match current deal or increase it if a deal is already in place
[*]Increased chance for scout to find improved sponsordeals based on gym operations score
[*]Increased chance for scout to find improved sponsordeals based on fame score
[*]Increased chance for rare special deals in Major circuit and World circuit
[*]Fixed issue with the scout only finding sponsordeals for one boxer ([i]Old issue from the previous game where the scout picks a boxer on your roster and then only finds new deals for this boxer and ignores the other boxers in your gym regardless of fame and competition status[/i])
[*]Increased manager experience gain by 10%
[*]Increased trigger size on manager spend button
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 4 with a BIG stamina rebalance is here!
notes.content:
Here is an update with a BIG stamina rebalance to improve all fights and a few other important fixes to improve gameplay overall. If you liked the game and did not leave a review yet please do it, you can help the game so much with just one review. Thanks for your support!

[b]Here are the patch notes (1.09.27):[/b]
[list]
[*]Talent "Head block" now also grants increased stamina gain
[*]Talent "Body block" now also grants increased stamina gain
[*]Decreased overall body damage ([i]Boxers now lose less stamina when taking a body hit which makes all fights more interesting[/i])
[*]Added 10 more character options to the custom recruit "Create boxer" menu
[*]Updated various talent description texts
[*]Slightly decreased opponents ultimate power gain in "Major" & "World" circuits
[*]Slightly decreased opponents (comeback) stat regain when rising from a knockout in "Major" & "World" circuits
[*]Fixed an issue with "MEGA" boost button not disappearing after a set duration
[*]Increased chance by fame events to get a contender fight in World circuit
[*]Increased fight preparation from training
[*]Increased chance to find a recruit with a trait from scouting
[*]Added preparation work for a new system with a database for tournaments ([i]Elimination knockout bracket[/i])
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 3
notes.content:
Here comes an important balance update with a spicy new freshly baked feature called "MEGA" boost. Thanks for your support. Enjoy!

[b]Here are the patch notes (1.08.26):[/b]
[list]
[*]Added new feature "MEGA" boost ([i]Powerful passive skill that has a chance to activate during a boost in training. Based on manager talent - training boost[/i])  
[*]Major circuit champion opponent difficulty slightly decreased 
[*]World circuit overall opponent difficulty slightly decreased 
[*]Doubled the amount of health gained from training (weightlift,jumprope and sparring)
[*]Added a 5-day cooldown for changing manager focus in the gym office desk
[*]Fixed a major issue in combat with opponents having less tired checks than the player
[*]Fixed repairman salary text showing the wrong cost
[*]Both scout notifiers now have updated placement 
[*]Fixed a texture error with jumprope
[*]Fixed an issue that removed repairman hire when expanding gym
[*]Added preparation work for a new system with a database for tournaments ([i]Elimination knockout bracket[/i])
[*]Added preparation work for interaction with "Axel Schroeder & Wolfpack Boxing Club" ([i]Tournament invitations[/i])
[*]Added preparation work for "B.R.O" rankings, a new overall ranking system of all boxers ([i]even free agents and unranked talents[/i]) in the world
[*]Numerous grammar fixes
[*]Updated several tooltips
[/list]

notes.title: Boxing School 2 is OUT!
notes.content:
We proudly present Boxing School 2 to the world. Get ready to fight. It is time to become king in the ring. The long-awaited sequel to Boxing School is finally out and now available on Steam...

[previewyoutube=GlCHdWMSSaU;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]DEVELOPMENT HISTORY[/h3]
When we as a 2-man team started working on the first Boxing School 8 years ago we could never have imagined the massive response it would get. It has been truly rewarding to see so many people playing and enjoying the game through the years. And it has been challenging to plan and develop the sequel in a way that maintains the feeling and soul of Boxing School.

This time we are a 3-man team that has great ambition with this successor. We want Boxing School 2 to be the best boxing tycoon management game out there. And we work very hard with alot of passion to make that happen. Let just say that we have the same "Eye of the tiger" attitude and look on our faces that our handdrawn boxers in the game has. It has not been easy but we are proud over the result.

Thank you to everyone for your support. We hope you'll enjoy the game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2627410/Boxing_School_2/

[h2]Special bundle offer for all of you[/h2]
For all our past supporters that already own the first game, this special bundle allows you to get Boxing School 2 at a special discount.
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/52553/

[h3]HELP US GAIN SOME MOMENTUM[/h3]
We are not a AAA publisher with endless resources and huge budgets. We are just 3 guys in a basement that loves making games and truth be told can barely afford to hire a translator. We have to fight for every inch to have a chance. 

If you want to be a big help to us please consider leaving a review on Steam. Reviews are incredibly important for indie games, especially during the first week of launch, and they help us get more visibility and momentum so the game can get off the ground abit. 

If you do, you’ll have our eternal gratitude. You can make a huge difference. Thank you again!

/From the guys making this game
